skills.name: Paper Swallow (紙燕)
skills.line: Through a thin sheet of paper, I live in the human world.
skills.description: Kamimai attack a single target with a paper fan, dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Also detonates all layers of Paper Blade on the target.

skills.name: Falling Papers (落紙)
skills.line: The moon still shines bright, yet the fallen papers have not returned.
skills.description:
When an enemy uses a skill, Kamimai gains a layer of Falling Papers (max of 1 layer), lasts for 1 turn.
All debuffs and control effects on her are dispelled at the start of her turn and consuming an equal number of Falling Paper layers. ;Falling Papers (落紙) : :'''Buff, Status''': Ignores 30 DEF.

upgrades.text: Max number of Falling Paper layers increases to 2.
Each Falling Papers layer increases her DEF by 10%
Max number of Falling Paper layers increases to 3.
When using Dancing Papers, each layer of Falling Papers decreases the onibi cost by 1.

skills.name: Dancing Papers (紙刃飛揚)
skills.line: I'm the girl in the painting, the paper blade in the wind.
skills.description: Kamimai performs a spinning dance to conjure a whirlwind of flaying paper among all enemies, inflicting them with Paper Blade, lasts for 2 turns. Also deals indirect damage equal to 108% of her ATK. ; : ;Paper Blade (紙刃) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Deals indirect damage at the end of turn. Paper Blade will detonate if an enemy inflicted with it uses a skill, removing this status and dealing indirect damage equal to 108% of Kamimai's ATK.

upgrades.text: Indirect damage increases to 110% and Paper Blade ignores 100 DEF.
Indirect damage increases to 112% and Paper Blade ignores 150 DEF.
Indirect damage increases to 114% and Paper Blade ignores 200 DEF.
Upon using this skill on enemies with Paper Blade, the duration is reset and inflicts an additional 154% of indirect damage equal to 154% of her ATK.
